title: Extract duplicated edge label editing logic into shared component
description: DRY VIOLATION: SmartEdge (smart-edge.tsx) and LabeledEdge (labeled-edge.tsx) contain ~95% identical inline label editing code: same useState for isEditing/editValue, same useRef for inputRef, same useEffect for focus/select, same handleDoubleClick/commitEdit/handleKeyDown/handleBlur callbacks, and same JSX rendering (EdgeLabelRenderer div with input or span). This is ~60 lines of duplicated logic per component. Fix: Extract an `EdgeLabelEditor` component that encapsulates the editing state, input rendering, and commit logic. Both edge components should render `<EdgeLabelEditor edgeId={id} label={label} labelX={labelX} labelY={labelY} />`. Also fixes a secondary bug: LabeledEdge's label div is missing dark mode classes (only has bg-white/90, text-gray-700 without dark: variants) while SmartEdge has them. SOLID violation: Single Responsibility — edge components handle both path computation AND inline editing UI.
